name: Hesperosuchus
sum: Hesperosuchus is an extinct crocodylomorph from the Late Triassic Chinle Formation of Arizona and New Mexico, once thought to be near the ancestry of theropod dinosaurs.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: AMNH 6758 - parts of the skull, lower jaw and a complete cervical series, with other bones, from the Petrified Forest Member of the Chinle Formation near Cameron, Arizona.
material: The holotype plus later specimens from Arizona and New Mexico described in the 1980s-2000s literature.
biology: Hollow bones and its skull and neck anatomy led it to be taken for a carnosaur-line ancestor, but later work places it near crocodilians; the sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet.
author: Colbert 1952
